==Ingredients==

* 4 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] [[Cookbook:Raspberry|raspberries]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
* [[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]]

==Procedure==

# Mash the berries and add the vinegar and let stand for 4 days.
# To each cup of liquid, add 1 cup of sugar.
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boil|boil]] and cook for 20 minutes.
# Strain and bottle.
